summary: Credly OAuth Integration testing completed successfully. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Credly panel, Connect/Sync/Disconnect buttons, badge cards with images, skills tags, and external links all working correctly in DEMO/SIMULATED mode.

backend_api_tests.supported_issuers_returns_list: PASS - 11 issuers including AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA

frontend_ui_tests.badge_cards_display: PASS - shows badge images, skills tags, issuing authority
frontend_ui_tests.demo_badges_imported: PASS - AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, PMP, CompTIA Security+, Google Cloud
frontend_ui_tests.supported_issuers_list: PASS - AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA, PMI, Docker, Kubernetes, +50 more

credly_oauth_flow.notes: GET /api/credentials/credly/auth returns auth_url and state token

credly_status.notes: GET /api/credentials/credly/status shows connection status with connected_at timestamp

credly_badges_list.notes: GET /api/credentials/credly/badges returns imported badges with source='credly'

credly_sync.notes: POST /api/credentials/credly/sync syncs badges and returns imported/updated counts

my_credentials_with_credly.notes: GET /api/credentials/my-credentials includes Credly badges with source='credly'

frontend_credly_panel.notes: Credly integration panel displays with Connect button, supported issuers list

frontend_badge_cards.notes: Badge cards show images, skills tags, issuing authority, dates, View button

critical_code_review_comments: Credly OAuth API is in DEMO/SIMULATED mode - returns sample badges when CREDLY_CLIENT_ID and CREDLY_CLIENT_SECRET are not configured
Demo mode clearly indicated in UI with message: 'Demo mode: Showing sample badges. Connect real Credly account for actual data.'
